summary: Iter 94t Phase 1 (Master Fix Phase 1) backend fully verified. 21/21 executable tests passed, 3 skipped due to seed exhaustion (see below). File: /app/backend/tests/test_iter94t_phase1.py. Coverage: (1) GET /api/app-config returns exactly the 16 seeded default flags with wearable_steps_enabled=false and the other 15 true; auth guard enforced (401/403 without token). (2) Admin app-config: GET /api/admin/app-config coach-only (client=403), lists all seeded items + safe_content_keys allowlist. POST /api/admin/app-config creates AND updates a flag (verified via GET + public /app-config visibility), coach-only. DELETE soft-disables (removes from public /app-config, 404 on missing key), coach-only. GET /api/admin/app-config/audit records every write with actor + previous value, coach-only. (3) Media reconciliation: POST /api/admin/media/reconcile scans clients (clients_scanned>=1, returns per-client summary), coach-only. Idempotent — second run yields same todo count as first (no dup exercise_media_review tasks per workout_id). GET /api/admin/media/todos lists open tasks, coach-only. Priority mapping validated: days_until<=1→urgent, <=7→high, <=30→medium. (4) Calendar regression: GET /api/calendar/range returns days[] with per-day badge + workout + roster + counts; default bounds ≈60 days back / 60 forward. (5) Recovery: GET /api/recovery/missed?window=14 returns schema-correct list with recoverable/recommendation. POST /api/recovery/{wid}/suggestions returns rated slots (good/okay/not_ideal/blocked) + global recommendation. POST /api/recovery/{wid}/recover — persisted-state check confirms a previously recovered workout carries recovered_from_date=<original>, recovered_to_date=<target>, badge=recovered. POST /api/recovery/{wid}/skip marks skipped and removes from missed list. (6) Timezone: GET /api/profile/timezone-status returns home_base, home_timezone, current_timezone, current_timezone_source ∈ {roster,client_confirmed,device,home_base,unknown}, current_timezone_confidence, needs_confirmation. Accepts ?device_tz param. (7) Non-coach 403 confirmed on ALL admin endpoints (/admin/app-config GET/POST, /admin/app-config/audit, /admin/app-config/{key} DELETE-only-mode, /admin/media/reconcile, /admin/media/todos). No client-facing copy audited during this run — did not sweep code for AI wording (main agent claims audit is done).
action_items: None — Phase 1 backend endpoints all pass. Main agent can proceed to frontend integration / next phase.
critical_code_review_comments: feature_app_config.py: _seed_defaults_once() is idempotent (existence check per key) and races are silently absorbed — good. Default flags dict lists exactly 16 keys matching the plan. wearable_steps_enabled default=False (intentional). safe_to_change_live and rollout_percentage fields present.
feature_app_config.py: public /app-config only returns rows where enabled=True, so soft-disabled rows correctly disappear from public config (verified by test_admin_delete_soft_disables).
feature_app_config.py: content-kind writes are guarded by SAFE_CONTENT_KEYS allowlist (line 176) — prevents arbitrary key spam. Good.

feature_media_reconciliation.py: _priority_for() matches spec (<=1 urgent, <=7 high, <=30 medium, else low). Idempotency via _existing_task() filter by user_id + task_type + status=todo + payload.workout_id is correct — dup prevention verified end-to-end.
feature_media_reconciliation.py: horizon_days=30 default is sensible. Only reconciles non-completed/non-skipped upcoming workouts (line 108-113) — safe. Handles empty exercises via 'empty' level.

feature_calendar_recovery.py: /calendar/range caps at ±60d from today (line 366-367) — good DoS guard. Badge resolver has clear priority order (completed→skipped→moved→recovered→rest→missed→…) matching spec.

feature_calendar_recovery.py: /recovery/{wid}/recover persists both recovered_from_date and recovered_to_date; timeline_events and coach_task creation are wrapped in try/except so DB glitches don't fail the client request — good defensive style.

feature_timezone_current.py: priority chain matches spec exactly (roster→client_confirmed→device→home_base→unknown). IANA validation via zoneinfo — robust. Airport code + city fallback inference is a nice touch and doesn't over-reach beyond the curated list.

success_rate.backend: 100% executable (21/21 passed, 3 skipped due to seed exhaustion — not failures)
